name: shiksha-admin-overview-tutorial
title: Explore platform and course analytics

chapters.caption: 01  Explore synthetic platform usage across three courses.
02  Change Today to This Week to compare the reporting period.
03  Open Total Tokens to compare each course's share.
04  Search for Electricity Basics; overall totals stay unchanged.
05  Inspect per-student token usage from the course row.
06  Compare rounds per student without changing course settings.

description: Explore the native admin overview with synthetic institution data: change the reporting period, filter course token usage, and inspect per-student tokens and rounds. Read-only; no live sign-in or model calls.

verification.productionSecurity: Not assessed; authentication and APIs are local browser-test fixtures.

courseChatStarters.reason: The native admin dashboard does not have course-chat starters.

capture: Actual unchanged React frontend; scripted interactions, synthetic course data and in-memory API responses.
timing: Captured frames are paced for readability, not a performance benchmark.
isolation: Fresh browser context. External services blocked; all API calls simulated. No remote course creation.
